name: 穿甲银弹
description: 选择正方向，破墙，并对6格内所有敌人造成4点伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,p=selectTarget({type:'grid',range:6,filter:'all'});if(!p||p.needsTargetSelection)return p;var dx=Math.sign(p.x-c.x),dy=Math.sign(p.y-c.y);if((dx===0&&dy===0)||(dx!==0&&dy!==0))return{success:false,message:'请选择施法者以外的方向格'};var cells=[];for(var i=1;i<=6;i++)cells.push({x:c.x+dx*i,y:c.y+dy*i});flow.effects.destroyWalls(cells);var es=battle.pieces.filter(function(x){return x.currentHp>0&&!arePlayersAllied(battle,x.ownerPlayerId,c.ownerPlayerId)&&cells.some(function(q){return q.x===x.x&&q.y===x.y;});});if(es.length)dealDamage(c,es,4,'physical',battle,context.skill.id);return{success:true,message:c.name+'发射穿甲银弹'};}
